title: Five new species of Hydnellum from the Changbai Mountains and Dabie Mountains, China
author: Yonglan Tuo
license_note: figshare article detail endpoint license.name: CC BY 4.0

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Extract total genomic DNA from dried specimens using the NuClear Plant Genomic DNA Kit (CoWin Biotech Co., Ltd., Jiangsu, China, catalog CW0531M) following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Set up ITS PCR mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a 15 µL PCR reaction for the ITS region containing: 1.0 µL genomic DNA template, 7.5 µL SanTaq® PCR Master Mix (Sangon Biotech, Shanghai, China, catalog B532081-0020), 1.0 µL ITS1F primer (10 µM), 1.0 µL ITS4 primer (10 µM), and 4.5 µL ddH₂O.

steps.title: Run ITS PCR
steps.instruction: Thermocycle the ITS reaction with: initial denaturation at 95 °C for 3.5 min; 35 cycles of 95 °C for 40 s, 56 °C for 45 s, 72 °C for 90 s; final extension at 72 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Set up nrLSU PCR mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a 15 µL PCR reaction for the nrLSU region containing: 1.0 µL genomic DNA template, 7.5 µL SanTaq® PCR Master Mix (catalog B532081-0020), 1.0 µL LROR primer (10 µM), 1.0 µL LR7 primer (10 µM), and 4.5 µL ddH₂O.

steps.title: Run nrLSU PCR
steps.instruction: Thermocycle the nrLSU reaction with: initial denaturation at 94 °C for 2 min; 35 cycles of 94 °C for 40 s, 56 °C for 60 s, 72 °C for 1.5 min; final extension at 72 °C for 8 min.

steps.title: Purify PCR amplicons
steps.instruction: Purify the ITS and nrLSU PCR amplicons using the DiaSpin Kit (Sangon Biotech, catalog B110093-0100).

steps.title: Submit amplicons for sequencing
steps.instruction: Send the purified amplicons to Comate Bioscience Co., Ltd. (Jilin, China) for Sanger sequencing.

steps.title: Assemble consensus sequences
steps.instruction: Assemble the raw sequencing reads into consensus sequences using SeqMan (DNASTAR, version 7.1).

steps.title: Deposit sequences in GenBank
steps.instruction: Submit the consensus ITS and nrLSU sequences to GenBank.
